rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that may become or happen but is not actual yet.

example.english: There is potential for this plan to start next year.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃有可能下年先開始。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 ho2 nang4 haa6 nin4 sin1 hoi1 ci2

rows.note: Use this for an unrealized possibility or capacity, especially before a noun such as 潛在客戶 or 潛在危險.

example.english: Potential dangers must not be ignored.
example.jyutping: cim4 zoi6 ngai4 him2 m4 ho2 ji5 fat1 si6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unrealized ability or capacity, especially someone’s ability to develop or achieve something.

example.english: This project still has great potential to develop into an international brand.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃仲有好大潛力，可以發展成國際品牌。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zung6 jau5 hou2 daai6 cim4 lik6 ho2 ji5 faat3 zin2 sing4 gwok3 zai3 ban2 paai4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing a person’s natural aptitude or talent, rather than general capacity.

example.english: Ming has a lot of potential; given some time, they’ll definitely get the hang of it.
example.traditional: 阿明好有潛質，俾啲時間佢一定學得識。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 hou2 jau5 cim4 zat1 bei2 di1 si4 gaan3 keoi5 jat1 ding6 hok6 dak1 sik1
